## Professional Summary

Global procurement and strategic sourcing leader with deep experience across consumer, retail, and digital commerce organizations. I've built centralized procurement functions from the ground up and driven performance and scale inside large, established companies, managing multi-billion-dollar global spend portfolios and delivering hundreds of millions in cost savings. I'm now pairing that operating experience with formal analytics training through Boston University's MS in Applied Business Analytics.
